# GEDCOM 7.0 extensions, enumerations, records and values.
#
# Format: `### ID | C|L | purpose (origin)`, then the GEDCOM input, then directives:
#   #want LINE    the written output contains this line
#   #model TEXT   the parsed model keeps this text (newline written \n)
#   #lacks TEXT   the written output does not contain this text
#   #target VERS  write as 5.5.1, 7.0 or 7.1 instead of the input's version
# Tokens: <CR> / <CRLF> end a line with that terminator, <NOEOL> ends the input without one,
# <TAB>, <BOM> and <U+XXXX> stand for those characters. Every name, place and value is fictitious.

### G7-SCHMA-TAG | C | documented extension round-trips with its SCHMA declaration
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
1 SCHMA
2 TAG _SKYPEID http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/skypeID
0 @I0@ INDI
1 _SKYPEID example.person
0 TRLR
#want 2 TAG _SKYPEID http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/skypeID
#want 1 _SKYPEID example.person

### G7-UNDOC-EXT | C | undocumented extension kept
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 _UNDOCUMENTED x
2 _SUB y
0 TRLR
#want 1 _UNDOCUMENTED x
#want 2 _SUB y

### G7-EXT-RECORD | C | extension record with xref and pointer to it
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 _LOC @P1@
0 @P1@ _LOC
1 NAME Somewhere
0 TRLR
#want 1 _LOC @P1@
#want 0 @P1@ _LOC

### G7-EXT-UNDER-STD | C | extension below standard substructure (registry: ext anywhere)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 BIRT
2 DATE 1 JAN 1900
3 _EXT kept
0 TRLR
#want 3 _EXT kept

### G7-STD-UNDER-EXT | C | standard tag under extension is opaque and kept
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 _X
2 TAG _Y http://example.com/y
0 TRLR
#want 2 TAG _Y http://example.com/y
